svg.aria-label: Animated coil: as the current rises its flux grows and a back-EMF opposes the rise with the entry terminal positive; with the current held steady the flux is constant and the EMF is zero; as the current falls the EMF polarity flips
svg.text: Figure 90 step by step: the back-EMF follows dI/dt, not I

text.tspan: Coil current, flux and back-EMF through one rise–hold–fall cycle — Figure 90 animated
